jobs.title: Agentic AI Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Software Developer, AI Solutions
📍 Remote | Montreal (must be a Permanent Resident - PR)
Build production-grade Agentic AI systems, not proofs of concept.

We are seeking a hands-on Software Developer
to design, build, and deploy enterprise-scale AI solutions that solve real business problems. This is a software engineering role focused on creating production-ready agentic systems using context, memory, guardrails, tool calling, orchestration, and AI-driven development workflows. NOTE: this is a not ML Engineer or Data Scientist

What You'll Do
Design and build enterprise-grade Agentic AI solutions and AI-powered applications.
Develop scalable backend services using Python
(and ideally Go or Rust).
Architect systems that integrate with multiple internal services while optimizing performance and latency.
Leverage agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot
to accelerate development.
Guide, validate, and improve AI-generated outputs, ensuring reliability, security, and production readiness.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and drive AI adoption across the SDLC.

What We're Looking For
✅ 7+ years of software engineering experience
✅ 3-5+ years building and deploying AI solutions in production environments
✅ Strong Python development experience
✅ Experience building Agentic AI systems
and enterprise-scale GenAI solutions
✅ Strong system design and software architecture skills
✅ Proven track record delivering highly available, production-grade applications
✅ Daily user of AI development tools such as Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex

Nice to Have
Go or Rust development experience
Experience modernizing SDLC processes with AI agents
LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, MCP, or agent orchestration frameworks
Kubernetes and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting
